conventions.order_spherical: p: x y z; l >= 2: m = -l..+l (real solid harmonics)
conventions.order_cartesian: lexicographic: xx xy xz yy yz zz, ...
conventions.normalisation: spherical: 1; cartesian l >= 2: radial part only (libcint)
conventions.packing_eri: 8-fold: ij = i(i+1)/2 + j for i >= j, value index ij(ij+1)/2 + kl for ij >= kl
